assertions.statement: Valid requests below the 80 MiB absolute limit are admitted or wait for bounded capacity instead of being rejected solely for exceeding 8 MiB.
Encoded or decoded requests above the configured absolute limit return 413.
A canceled waiter releases its queue slot and temporary spool without invoking a provider.
Queue saturation returns request_capacity_unavailable and does not alter provider auth or cooldown state.
Zstd, Responses WebSocket, multipart image, and video form inputs share bounded request-size protection.
assertions.evidence_ref: go test ./... and protocol handler tests
